policy: Accepted evidence must be a native post or native comment authored by a real person listed in src/lib/social/top-voices.ts.
Accepted evidence must mention the Spring/P26 2026 company, founder, official handle, or domain in the top voice row itself or visible native card context.
Accepted evidence must have a verifiable source URL and visible metrics.
Profiles, organization accounts, search pages, inferred metrics, company reposts, founder-authored thanks posts, and top voice mentions by others are rejected.
Candidates already represented in targeted-evidence-current.json by sourceUrl or platformPostId are not accepted again.
